hero.title: TRAVEL WITHOUT BOUNDARIES
hero.subtitle: We create a safe, accessible, and inspiring environment for women traveling across the Kyrgyz Republic

about.title: WHY AIYM PATH WAS CREATED
about.description: A pilot initiative financed through the Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) Competitive Fund of the Asian Development Bank (ADB). GESI is a key ADB priority, and this project was designed to empower women and foster a safe, equitable travel community in Kyrgyzstan.

genderBalance.title: Industry Gender Balance
genderBalance.description: Addressing tourism sector imbalances, ensuring equal conditions, comfort, and security for women travelers.

womenEmpowerment.title: Women's Empowerment
womenEmpowerment.description: Training and encouraging female guides, expanding entrepreneurship opportunities in tourism.

routeMapping.title: Route Mapping & Safety
routeMapping.description: Designing verified hiking trails, accessible services, certified stays with interactive digital mapping.

guides.title: GUIDES & TRAVEL AGENTS
guides.subtitle: Professional verified guides and agents making your journey safe, clear, and unforgettable.

concept.title: WHAT FEMALE-FRIENDLY MEANS
concept.intro: An approach to tourism development where women's safety, comfort, and preferences are factored in at every journey stage — from route planning to stays and guiding.
concept.kyrgyzstanContext: Crucial for Kyrgyzstan: while the country boasts tremendous natural and cultural tourism potential, safety assurances, quality stays, and clear logistics are vital for solo and group female travelers.
concept.femaleFriendlyOffers: Female-friendly elevates the tourism experience for everyone by providing:
points: Safe, verified, and well-marked hiking trails;
Certified guest houses and tourist amenities;
Transparent information on terrain and risks.

locations.title: PROJECT TERRITORY
locations.subtitle: At launch, our focus is centered on verified trails and services across three premier destinations:

alaArcha.title: Ala-Archa Gorge
alaArcha.desc: Scenic hiking trails near Bishkek with established basic infrastructure and alpine vistas.

alamedin.title: Alamedin Gorge
alamedin.desc: Picturesque nature paths leading to mountain waterfalls and geothermal hot springs.

chunkurchak.title: Chunkurchak Valley
chunkurchak.desc: High alpine plateau offering panoramic Chui valley views and family-friendly eco-services.

cta.title: JOIN THE AIYM PATH INITIATIVE!
cta.description: Support the growth of female-friendly tourism in Kyrgyzstan and help build exceptional experiences for female travelers.
